name: hud_ui_check_toggle_widget_show_preview
description: HudUiCheckToggleWidget::ShowPreview skips disabled or checked toggles, otherwise plays rollover sound if present and delegates to the base ZRD preview.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiCheckToggleWidget source-cluster pass.
The rollover sound branch is accepted through the already functional zSndSample::PlayA3DSimple dependency and null-sound UI smoke coverage, without instantiating a live audio backend in this target.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b7210 validates the disabled and checked early returns, optional zSndSample::PlayA3DSimple call storing rolloverPlayHandle, and delegation to HudUiZrdWidget::ShowPreview.
Native smoke zhud_check_toggle_widget_helpers_smoke verifies normal unchecked preview delegates to the base ZRD preview, checked preview is skipped, and disabled unchecked preview is skipped.
